name: @prysmid/mcp

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List Prysmid workspaces accessible to the current API token. Returns an array of {id, slug, display_name, plan, state}.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Get a single workspace by slug or id.

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Create a new Prysmid workspace. Provisioning runs in the background; the response returns immediately with state=provisioning. Poll `get_workspace` until state=active (~30s).

tools.name: create_organization
tools.description: Create a new organization inside a workspace. Returns the org with a stable `tenant_id` UUID — that's the value users will see as the `tenant_id` claim on their JWT when an active grant resolves to this org. Idempotent on slug: re-creating a duplicate slug returns 409.

slug.description: URL-safe slug, unique per workspace. Immutable. Cannot be `__consumer__` (reserved).

allow_register.description: Whether self-registration is allowed for this org. Default false (invite-only).

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List all organizations in a workspace, oldest first. Each item includes the stable `tenant_id` UUID and the consumer flag.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Read one organization by its Zitadel org id (the `id` returned by create/list, not the internal Prysm:ID UUID).

tools.name: update_organization
tools.description: Rename an organization and/or toggle `allow_register` / `domain_auto_claim`. Sparse — omit fields to leave them untouched. Rename propagates to Zitadel synchronously.

domain_auto_claim.description: P2e opt-in: when True, verifying a domain on this org (or calling reconcile_organization_domain_claims) auto-grants the org access over consumer-org users with a matching verified email domain. Public domains are always excluded; the user's home org is never moved (the claim is an additional, revocable grant).

tools.name: reconcile_organization_domain_claims
tools.description: P2e: grant this org access over consumer-org users whose verified email domain matches one of the org's verified domains. Idempotent and re-runnable — catches users who self-registered after a domain was verified. Requires domain_auto_claim=true on the org (returns skipped with a reason otherwise). Public email domains are always excluded; the user's home org is never moved. Returns counts: granted / already_present / candidates + the domains matched.

tools.name: deactivate_organization
tools.description: Block all logins to an organization. Idempotent. Consumer org cannot be deactivated — toggle `allow_consumer_org=false` on the workspace instead.

tools.name: reactivate_organization
tools.description: Re-enable logins for a previously deactivated organization. Idempotent.

tools.name: delete_organization
tools.description: Hard-delete an organization. Cascades users/projects/grants on the Zitadel side. Idempotent against out-of-band Zitadel removal. Consumer org is protected — toggle `allow_consumer_org=false` on the workspace to remove it.

tools.name: ensure_consumer_organization
tools.description: Idempotently provision the workspace's consumer organization for self-registered users. Requires `workspace.allow_consumer_org=true` (toggle it via update_workspace first). Returns the org row whether newly created or already present. Slug `__consumer__`, `allow_register=true`, `is_consumer=true`.

tools.name: list_organization_domains
tools.description: List every domain attached to an organization with its verification state. Use after add/verify to confirm the domain shows `is_verified=true`.

org_id.description: Zitadel org id (the `id` returned by create/list_organizations). Per-org scoping.

tools.name: add_organization_domain
tools.description: Attach a domain to an organization. State starts UNVERIFIED — chain `generate_organization_domain_verification` and `verify_organization_domain` to complete setup. 409 if already attached.

org_id.description: Zitadel org id (the `id` returned by create/list_organizations). Per-org scoping.

domain.description: Fully-qualified domain to manage. Lower-case only — `Acme.com` and `acme.com` are different to Zitadel.

tools.name: generate_organization_domain_verification
tools.description: Generate (or rotate) the verification token + record location for an attached domain. Returns `{token, url, method}`. The operator must publish the token at `url` (DNS TXT for method=dns; HTTP file for method=http) before calling `verify_organization_domain`. DNS is the default — works on apex domains, does not require HTTP control.

org_id.description: Zitadel org id (the `id` returned by create/list_organizations). Per-org scoping.

domain.description: Fully-qualified domain to manage. Lower-case only — `Acme.com` and `acme.com` are different to Zitadel.

method.description: Verification method. `dns` (default) → publish a TXT record. `http` → serve a file at `.well-known/zitadel-challenge/<token>` on the domain.

tools.name: verify_organization_domain
tools.description: Trigger Zitadel to look up the published verification token and mark the domain verified. Returns the updated domain projection with `is_verified=true` on success. 400 if the token is not found (DNS not propagated yet, wrong record, etc.) — retry after publishing.

org_id.description: Zitadel org id (the `id` returned by create/list_organizations). Per-org scoping.

domain.description: Fully-qualified domain to manage. Lower-case only — `Acme.com` and `acme.com` are different to Zitadel.

tools.name: delete_organization_domain
tools.description: Detach a domain from an organization. Idempotent (204 even if already gone). Verified domains can be removed too — domain discovery will no longer route logins of that email domain to this org.

org_id.description: Zitadel org id (the `id` returned by create/list_organizations). Per-org scoping.

domain.description: Fully-qualified domain to manage. Lower-case only — `Acme.com` and `acme.com` are different to Zitadel.

tools.name: grant_user_to_organization
tools.description: Grant a user access to an organization's project with a set of role keys. The user does NOT need to be a member of the org — that's the point. Idempotent at the (user, org, project) tuple: duplicates return 502 from Zitadel.

org_id.description: Zitadel org id of the org GRANTING access.

user_id.description: Zitadel user id. The user's home org is irrelevant — grants are cross-org.

project_id.description: Zitadel project id this grant is for. Look it up via list_apps — every OIDC app belongs to a project.

role_keys.description: Role keys defined on the target project. Empty list = bare membership (still gates access).

tools.name: list_grants_in_organization
tools.description: List all grants owned by an organization. Returns each grant with the granted user_id, project_id, role_keys, and the org's tenant_id (the value users will see as `tenant_id` claim when this grant is active).

tools.name: list_grants_for_user
tools.description: List all grants held by a user across orgs in this workspace. Useful for 'what does this user have access to?' and offboarding/audit reviews.

tools.name: update_grant_roles
tools.description: Replace the role_keys on an existing grant. The set is replaced wholesale — pass the full desired list, not a delta.

tools.name: deactivate_grant
tools.description: Temporarily suspend a grant without revoking it. Idempotent. Re-enable later with reactivate_grant.

tools.name: reactivate_grant
tools.description: Re-enable a previously deactivated grant. Idempotent.

tools.name: revoke_grant
tools.description: Permanently revoke a grant. Idempotent — 204 even if the Zitadel-side grant is already gone. Emits a `grant.revoked` audit event (will fire a webhook in slice X5).

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List all OIDC apps in a workspace.

tools.name: create_oidc_app
tools.description: Create an OIDC application in a workspace. Returns client_id (and client_secret only when app_type=web). app_type=web is a confidential server-rendered app; spa and native are public clients that use PKCE and have no secret. Pass grant_types to enable e.g. device_code for a CLI/headless client in one call (default is authorization_code + refresh_token). access_token_type defaults to jwt (validatable offline via JWKS); use bearer only if the resource server validates by introspection.

grant_types.description: OAuth grant types to enable. Omit for [authorization_code, refresh_token]. Include device_code for a CLI/device-flow client.

access_token_type.description: jwt (default) for offline JWKS validation; bearer for opaque tokens requiring introspection.

dev_mode.description: Skip redirect URI HTTPS check — only for local dev, NEVER prod.

tools.name: delete_oidc_app
tools.description: Delete an OIDC app. Idempotent — 404 returns success.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Fetch full detail for one OIDC app: redirect URIs, grant types, auth method, dev_mode, timestamps. Never returns the client_secret — use regenerate_app_secret to mint a new one.

tools.name: update_app
tools.description: Patch mutable fields on an OIDC app: redirect URIs, post-logout URIs, grant types, auth method, access_token_type, dev_mode. All fields optional — only provided keys change. client_secret is NEVER accepted here; use regenerate_app_secret to rotate it.

access_token_type.description: jwt for offline JWKS validation; bearer for opaque tokens requiring introspection.

dev_mode.description: Skip redirect URI HTTPS check — only for local dev, NEVER prod.

tools.name: regenerate_app_secret
tools.description: Destructive — invalidates the current secret immediately. Returns the new secret plaintext ONCE. Set confirm=true to proceed. Only valid for app_type=web (confidential clients); spa/native are public and have no secret (the API returns 422 in that case).

confirm.description: Must be true to acknowledge that the current secret will be invalidated immediately.

tools.name: list_idps
tools.description: List identity providers (Google/GitHub/Microsoft/OIDC) configured on a workspace. Pass `org_id` to list IdPs of a specific business org.

org_id.description: Optional Zitadel org id to scope this operation to a specific business org inside the workspace. Omit for the workspace's home org (backwards-compat).

tools.name: add_idp
tools.description: Add an identity provider to the workspace and attach it to the login policy in one atomic call. Pass `org_id` to attach the IdP to a specific business org (multi-tenant setup) instead of the workspace's home org. Pass `provider_options` to control JIT provisioning + account-linking behaviour (X6).

org_id.description: Optional Zitadel org id to scope this operation to a specific business org inside the workspace. Omit for the workspace's home org (backwards-compat).

type.description: Identity provider kind. `microsoft` covers Azure AD / Entra.

name.description: Display name shown on login screen

tenant_id.description: Optional for `microsoft` — lock to a specific Entra tenant GUID. Default accepts any account.

provider_options.description: X6: JIT + linking behaviour. Omitted fields fall back to defaults on create (auto-create + auto-update + link-by-username) or preserve current state on patch.

is_auto_creation.description: JIT provisioning: True auto-creates a Prysm:ID user on first external login. The most common X6 flag — set False for tightly-controlled enterprise tenants where seats are granted manually.

auto_linking.description: How to merge an external first-login into an existing Prysm:ID user. `username` matches user_name, `email` matches verified email, `unspecified` disables auto-linking.

tools.name: delete_idp
tools.description: Remove an identity provider. Strips it from the login policy then deletes the config. Idempotent. Pass `org_id` to target a specific business org's IdP.

org_id.description: Optional Zitadel org id to scope this operation to a specific business org inside the workspace. Omit for the workspace's home org (backwards-compat).

tools.name: get_idp
tools.description: Fetch full detail for one identity provider: type, state, client_id, issuer/tenant (when applicable), scopes, secret_updated_at, created_at. Never returns the client_secret. Pass `org_id` to scope to a business org.

org_id.description: Optional Zitadel org id to scope this operation to a specific business org inside the workspace. Omit for the workspace's home org (backwards-compat).

tools.name: update_idp
tools.description: Patch mutable fields on an identity provider. All fields optional. Passing client_secret rotates the upstream-issued value (Google/GitHub/Microsoft/OIDC client secret stored in Prysmid). Passing client_id retargets to a different upstream client. issuer/tenant_id apply only when relevant to the IdP type. Pass `org_id` to scope to a business org. Pass `provider_options` to flip JIT or linking flags — only the keys you set change, others are preserved (X6).

org_id.description: Optional Zitadel org id to scope this operation to a specific business org inside the workspace. Omit for the workspace's home org (backwards-compat).

client_secret.description: Rotate the upstream-issued client secret. Not the Prysmid app secret — that one is rotated via regenerate_app_secret.

tenant_id.description: Only meaningful for type=microsoft (Entra tenant GUID).

provider_options.description: X6: JIT + linking behaviour. Omitted fields fall back to defaults on create (auto-create + auto-update + link-by-username) or preserve current state on patch.

is_auto_creation.description: JIT provisioning: True auto-creates a Prysm:ID user on first external login. The most common X6 flag — set False for tightly-controlled enterprise tenants where seats are granted manually.

auto_linking.description: How to merge an external first-login into an existing Prysm:ID user. `username` matches user_name, `email` matches verified email, `unspecified` disables auto-linking.

tools.name: probe_idp
tools.description: Probe an external identity provider end-to-end against its upstream authorize endpoint. Catches redirect_uri_mismatch (URI not registered at Google Cloud / GitHub / etc.), invalid_client (client_id rotated or deleted upstream), and provider_unreachable failures BEFORE a real end-user hits them. Use after enable_google_login / add_idp, and any time you suspect the IdP is misconfigured. Today: Google + GitHub get full classification; Microsoft + OIDC generic return `skipped` for the deterministic dimensions (only reachability is verified). Pass `org_id` to scope to a business org.

org_id.description: Optional Zitadel org id to scope this operation to a specific business org inside the workspace. Omit for the workspace's home org (backwards-compat).

tools.name: get_login_policy
tools.description: Return the workspace's current login policy (auth methods, MFA factors, passwordless, domain discovery, hide-password-reset, etc.). Pass `org_id` to read a specific business org's policy.

org_id.description: Optional Zitadel org id to scope this operation to a specific business org. Omit for the workspace's home org (backwards-compat).

tools.name: update_login_policy
tools.description: Update the login policy. PATCH semantics — only fields you pass are changed; other policy fields stay as they were. Pass `org_id` to scope to a specific business org (P3a-3). Set `allow_domain_discovery=true` together with a verified org domain (see `verify_organization_domain`) to route email-based logins to that org automatically.

org_id.description: Optional Zitadel org id to scope this operation to a specific business org. Omit for the workspace's home org (backwards-compat).

force_mfa.description: Require any second factor at login.

force_mfa_local_only.description: X2: require MFA only for username/password logins, exempting external-IdP logins (which may already enforce MFA upstream). Only meaningful when force_mfa is also true.

second_factors.description: Replaces the full list of allowed second-factor methods. Pass `[]` to disable all 2FA.

multi_factors.description: Replaces the full list of allowed multi-factor (passwordless+verification) methods.

allow_domain_discovery.description: P3a-3: route logins to the org that owns the typed email's verified domain, skipping the IdP picker. Requires at least one verified domain on the org (see verify_organization_domain).

tools.name: list_service_accounts
tools.description: List the workspace's service accounts (machine users). The platform-internal provisioner SA is filtered out. Pass `org_id` to list a specific business org's machine users.

org_id.description: Optional Zitadel org id to scope the service account to a specific business org. Omit for the workspace's home org (backwards-compat).

tools.name: create_service_account
tools.description: Create a service account (machine user) and mint its JSON key. The `key` is returned ONCE in the response and never stored by Prysmid — surface it to the operator and instruct them to save it in a secret manager. Pass `org_id` to create the SA inside a specific business org.

org_id.description: Optional Zitadel org id to scope the service account to a specific business org. Omit for the workspace's home org (backwards-compat).

user_name.description: Machine username (Zitadel handle). Cannot be the reserved `prysmid-provisioner`.

tools.name: delete_service_account
tools.description: Revoke a service account. Idempotent (204 even if already gone). Refuses to delete the platform provisioner SA. Pass `org_id` to target a specific business org's machine user.

org_id.description: Optional Zitadel org id to scope the service account to a specific business org. Omit for the workspace's home org (backwards-compat).

tools.name: export_audit_log
tools.description: Export a workspace's audit trail as NDJSON (default) or CSV. Filter by `org_id` (a specific business org, matches meta.org_id), `action` (exact, e.g. `idp.create`), and a created_at window (`start`/`end`, ISO-8601). `limit` caps rows (default 10000, max 50000). Returns the raw export text — narrow the window to page through large trails.

format.description: ndjson (default) = one JSON object per line, best for SIEM. csv = flat columns with meta JSON-encoded in one cell.

org_id.description: Scope to one business org (matches meta.org_id). Omit for the whole workspace.

action.description: Exact audit action to filter, e.g. `idp.create`.

start.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; only rows created at/after this.

end.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; only rows created before this.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List human users in a workspace.

tools.name: invite_user
tools.description: Invite a user by email. Idempotent by email — re-inviting an existing user is a no-op. Triggers a Zitadel init email with a 'set your password' link.

tools.name: start_user_passkey
tools.description: Start passkey (WebAuthn) enrollment for an end user. Default delivery='email': Zitadel mails the registration link to the user — safe, the link never transits this tool. delivery='link' returns the raw link: it is a BEARER CREDENTIAL (whoever opens it enrolls THEIR authenticator on the account, and with passwordless allowed that passkey signs in without password or TOTP). Only request 'link' for controlled support flows, never print or log it. The user must exist (404 user.not_found otherwise); requires the workspace login policy to allow passwordless for the passkey to be usable at sign-in.

delivery.description: email (default): Zitadel mails the link to the user. link: returns the raw registration link — sensitive, handle as a secret.

tools.name: delete_user
tools.description: Delete a user by id. Idempotent.

tools.name: get_branding
tools.description: Return the workspace's active branding policy (colors, fonts, hide-prysmid-watermark flag, logo URLs).

tools.name: update_branding
tools.description: Update branding colors and watermark. Hex colors as `#RRGGBB`. Activates the policy after update — change shows on next login screen render.

disable_watermark.description: Hide 'Powered by Prysmid' on the login screen (Pro+ only — Free silently ignored).

tools.name: get_billing
tools.description: Get current billing state: plan, subscription status, current period, spending_cap_cents, signups_blocked.

tools.name: set_spending_cap
tools.description: Cap monthly Pro overage spend (cents). Pass null to remove cap (unlimited). When projected overage exceeds cap, signups_blocked flips on.

spending_cap_cents.description: Max overage cents per period; null = unlimited

tools.name: start_billing_checkout
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout session for upgrading. Returns the URL the user must visit. Plan must be `pro` (Free has no checkout; Enterprise is sales-only).

tools.name: start_billing_portal
tools.description: Create a Stripe customer-portal session URL where the user manages payment methods, downloads invoices, cancels subscription.

tools.name: create_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Register a new outbound webhook endpoint for a workspace. Returns the freshly-generated `signing_secret` EXACTLY ONCE — store it immediately to verify deliveries; it is NOT retrievable later. HTTPS required in prod. Empty `enabled_events` = catch-all (subscribe to everything).

url.description: Destination URL. Must be https:// in production; http:// is permitted only on dev/staging environments.

description.description: Human label so you can tell endpoints apart in the dashboard.

enabled_events.description: Event types this endpoint subscribes to. Empty = catch-all. Unknown event types return 422.

tools.name: list_webhook_endpoints
tools.description: List all outbound webhook endpoints registered for a workspace. Does NOT return signing secrets — that's only on create.

tools.name: get_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Read one webhook endpoint by id. Omits the signing secret — recreate the endpoint if it was lost.

tools.name: update_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Sparse update of an endpoint's url / description / enabled_events / enabled flag. Omit fields to leave them untouched. signing_secret is NOT mutable — to rotate, delete and recreate.

enabled.description: Toggle deliveries without losing config. Useful when the destination is temporarily down.

tools.name: delete_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Permanently remove a webhook endpoint. Pending deliveries to it are NOT removed (operator can inspect them) but no new deliveries will be queued.

tools.name: setup_prysmid_workspace
tools.description: Create a new workspace and wait until it's fully provisioned (Zitadel instance, SMTP, DNS). Returns the live auth_domain ready to integrate.

timeout_seconds.description: Max time to wait for provisioning before returning.

tools.name: enable_google_login
tools.description: Add Google as an identity provider on a workspace and enable external IdPs in the login policy. Hands you a checklist if external IdPs were already disabled — agent should confirm before flipping that flag.

tools.name: prysmid_setup_check
tools.description: Run a readiness checklist on a workspace: state=active, ≥1 OIDC app, ≥1 IdP OR password+register enabled, branding has a primary_color set, login_policy reasonable, AND (by default) every external IdP probes successfully against its upstream provider. Returns pass/fail per item plus a summary verdict. Set `probe_idps=false` to skip the live probe (faster, but won't catch redirect_uri_mismatch or invalid client_secret until a real end-user hits the broken IdP).

probe_idps.description: Run a live probe against each external IdP's upstream authorize endpoint. Default true. Set false to skip if the latency matters more than the safety (will not catch redirect_uri_mismatch or invalid_client until a real end-user signs in).
